snippet.title: Ponpu - Release Date Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
Get ready to smash some eggs in Ponpu, launching November 5th! 
A frantic love letter to simpler times, Ponpu mixes classic gameplay with some new twists, all packaged in gorgeous, hand-drawn graphics. Battle through an epic campaign before taking the fight online against in hectic brawls for up to 4 players!
